readout_other: Morris water maze; Y-maze; CA1 LFP and spikes
direction_notes: Both 40 Hz and 200 Hz PRF TUS improved memory in APP/PS1 mice and increased CA1 gamma, ripple and SPW-R measures; effects differed by PRF and persisted days after stimulation.

exposures.label: TUS1 (40 Hz PRF) and TUS2 (200 Hz PRF) to CA1

timing.protocol_description: TUS1: 1 MHz, SD 10 s, PRF 40 Hz, DC 5%; TUS2: same with PRF 200 Hz. Total TUS time 1 h per day for 6 days, delivered to awake mice.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Eighteen APP/PS1 mice were randomly assigned to the AD (n = 6), AD+TUS1 (n = 6, 40 Hz ultrasound), and AD+TUS2 (n = 6, 200 Hz ultrasound) groups.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Two pulse repetition frequencies, corresponding to gamma (TUS1) and ripple (TUS2) oscillations, were applied for 1 h daily over 6 days to investigate TUS effects on neural activity and memory in AD mice (Figure S1B).

source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: In the TUS system, a signal from one function generator, modulated by another (AFG3022C, Tektronix, USA), was amplified by a linear RF power amplifier (E&I240L, ENI Inc., USA) and transmitted to the ultrasound transducer (V302-SU, Olympus, USA), generating ultrasound waves.
